about: What `init --from sodium.json` must write as agent-entry.json offers[] for fixtures/cli/sodium.json, in order (spec/tools-v1.md 3.1). The id splits at the first `_` into verb and of; description -> about; input keeps types only (v1 has no optional marker); on -> page.on; run request/form/extract/navigate/call -> page.do fetch/fill/read/open/call; risk -> effect (read_only none, state_changing changes, financial pays); confirmation -> ask (recommended advised, required always). `name`, `title` and `output` have no equivalent and are dropped. No offer gets a `door` binding: nothing is invented.

offers.about: Search the lamp catalogue by words or category.
Hold one lamp for pickup within 48 hours.
Pay for a held lamp at the shop's own checkout.
